messages:
anna lee: Scheduling note: vendor pentest confirmed for May 12-14. We need a hardened handoff: RBAC temporary roles, KMS unwrap constraints, detailed audit exports, and a retest cadence.
sam patel: Proposal: issue timebound role 'pt_vendor' for 48h, blocked from kms:Decrypt. Use a decryption proxy service that runs in a sealed task to produce the bundle.
devon: I'll own the proxy. It will accept a request with artifact IDs, perform decryption using our envelope key (or customer-supplied key if provided), write decrypted artifacts to a controlled S3 prefix, then remove plaintext. All operations logged to immutable audit stream.
leah: Ops notes: IDP should issue the role only after two approvals: ops lead + security SME. TTL set to 2 days by default, no extension without exec signoff. Also set network egress rules for the proxy task.
anna lee: Good. We should capture the following in the evidence snapshot: app logs (tail last 72h), infra events (full window), authz events (per-token markers), DB schema dump, and config snapshots.
sam patel: Packaging flow draft: 1) create ephemeral workspace 2) run export scripts 3) upload encrypted archive to s3://pt-handoffs/<run-id>/ 4) generate presigned URL (48h) 5) deliver URL to assessor via secure channel.
devon: Encryption options: if client gives their KMS key, we encrypt with that key. If not, encrypt with our envelope key and wrap KEK in HSM; we record key-id in manifest.
leah: For auditing, include a decrypt audit row for each artifact: timestamp, service-account, key-id, operation-id, justification ticket. That should satisfy auditors.
ops-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Block deployments for May 11-15 in deployment calendar. React with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge.
anna lee: Triage process for findings: triage channel #pt-triage -> create vuln ticket, label severity, assign owner, target fix window, and flag for retest. Include reproduction steps and logs.
sam patel: Retest coordination: offer two 1-day retest windows within 14 days of patch. If high severity, prioritize a same-week hotfix + retest.
devon: Implementation detail for proxy: it will never expose raw keys in logs, only operation metadata and HSM key-id. Proxy will rotate ephemeral credentials per-run and purge them post-run.
leah: RBAC gating: do not issue roles if there are open critical deployments or DB migrations scheduled. Integrate with the deployment calendar check in the runbook.
legal-dept: Reminder: we need a signed DPA and a confidentiality addendum for any assessor that will receive plaintext. Please get legal sign-off before URL issuance.
anna lee: Good catch. Add legal checkpoint before presign generation.
sam patel: Example presign command for automation:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://pt-handoffs/4280012345/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 172800
```
devon: Example manifest schema (CSV):
```
artifact_id,filename,sha256,key_id,created_at
4280012345,app-logs.tar.gz,aa11bb...,arn:aws:kms:...,2026-05-12T09:12:00Z
```
leah: Also include an integrity verification step: assessor must provide checksum confirmation within 24h of download. Store confirmation in vault.
anna lee: Action items: Sam -> runbook + approval workflow (due 2026-04-20). Devon -> proxy implementation + audit events (due 2026-04-28). Leah -> idp TTL + deployment calendar gating (due 2026-05-04). Legal -> DPA template ready (due 2026-04-15).
ops-bot: REMINDER: Create run id 4280012345 and seed manifest in secrets-vault with access controls.
sam patel: I'll produce a sample bundle in staging for validation and post link here. Also adding a short rollback checklist for fixes that require DB changes.
devon: One more security note: no live streaming of production logs to assessor. If a vendor requests live access, escalate to execs + legal and only allow via jumpbox with recorded session.
leah: Acknowledged. Locking docs and runbook references under /runbooks/pen-tests/4280012345.
legal-dept: Will prepare the DPA draft and ping Anna when ready.
anna lee: Thanks everyone. Once runbook is final, we'll circulate to vendor and schedule a pre-window dry run.
